name: Godrej Industries Ltd.
about: Godrej Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the chemical, agriculture, real estate, vegetable oil, hospitality, and financial and investment businesses in India and internationally. The company produces and sells fatty acids, fatty alcohols, esters and emulsifying waxes, refined glycerin, alpha olefin sulphonates, sodium lauryl sulphate, and sodium lauryl ether sulphate. It also offers compound feeds for cattle, poultry, shrimp, and fish. In addition, the company provides refined vegetable and vanaspati oil; and engages in oil trading and oil palm plantation business. Further, it is involved in real estate sales, development, and leave, licensing and leasing activities; financial services business; and crop protection business. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~21% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~9% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 11.4% cost of equity).
PE of 24 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 35), though that is a short history to judge by.
High leverage (D/E 4.6x) raises risk; equity value is sensitive to interest costs.
